purpose: Voice assistant implementation modeled on F.R.I.D.A.Y. using LiveKit Agents and FastMCP backend.
capabilities: Real-time turn taking and silence detection
architecture_patterns: Decoupled voice-agent runtime and tool-execution server
security_notes: Exposes system commands; requires strict capability boundary and command allowlist
license_notes: MIT License allows commercial use, modification, and integration with attribution

purpose: Autonomous agentic command center and MCP tool orchestration for enterprise operations.
architecture_patterns: Single command layer over distributed tools
security_notes: Sensitive API tokens must be isolated from client payloads
license_notes: Apache-2.0 allows use, modification, and sublicensing with copyright notice

purpose: Modular SDK for building autonomous software engineering agents with real tool execution.
capabilities: Repo-level AST navigation and file editing
architecture_patterns: Separation of agent core from UI and runtime
security_notes: Arbitrary command execution must be gated by execution policy (READ_ONLY vs PROJECT_WRITE)

purpose: Command-line AI pair programmer with git-aware diff application and repo mapping.
capabilities: Surgical unified diff generation and application
Automatic git commit on test pass, rollback on test failure
architecture_patterns: Repo map ranking via PageRank over code symbols
Diff parser with fuzzy line matching and fallback to whole-file replacement
security_notes: Edits must be restricted to project directory to prevent path traversal attacks
license_notes: Apache-2.0 allows integration with proper attribution

purpose: Make websites accessible for AI agents via Playwright and Chrome DevTools Protocol.
capabilities: Interactive DOM tree extraction with highlighted interactive indices
Real browser clicking, typing, navigation, and scrolling
SPA and dynamic client rendering support
architecture_patterns: DOM simplification and bounding-box coordinate tracking
Multi-step planner with visual observation loop
security_notes: Malicious web pages can inject prompt instructions into extracted DOM text. External HTML must be sanitized and treated as untrusted DATA.

purpose: Library for building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs using cyclical graphs.
architecture_patterns: Conditional edge branching based on verified outputs
Crash recovery from persistent storage checkpoints
security_notes: State serialization must prevent arbitrary code deserialization vulnerabilities

purpose: Type-safe Python agent framework with strict schema validation and model neutrality.
capabilities: Strict schema validation for inputs and outputs
Dependency injection and tool execution boundaries
Streaming responses with partial schema validation
architecture_patterns: System defines truth; LLM output conforms to schema or fails immediately
security_notes: Schema validation blocks unparsed payload attacks

purpose: Open-source LLM engineering platform for observability, tracing, metrics, and prompt evaluations.
capabilities: Detailed hierarchical traces (Task -> Step -> Agent -> Tool -> Model)
Latency, token usage, and cost tracking
Error detection and quality evaluation tracking
security_notes: Mask sensitive user credentials and keys in traces

purpose: Framework for building real-time, bi-directional voice and multimodal AI agents.
architecture_patterns: Instant cancellation of active TTS audio buffer when user speaks
Audio state machine (Listening, Thinking, Speaking, Error)
security_notes: WebRTC/audio streaming requires secure session tokens

purpose: Autonomous agent framework with persistent memory and DSPy-based prompt self-evolution.
capabilities: Automated prompt tuning based on task feedback
architecture_patterns: Self-evolution loop: Observe failure -> Propose prompt diff -> Test against benchmark -> Deploy
security_notes: Never allow automated prompt optimization to overwrite security guards

purpose: Privacy-focused, local-first voice AI assistant with pluggable providers and tool hooks.
capabilities: Local-first execution priority with Ollama and cloud fallbacks
Persistent SQLite conversation and task state
architecture_patterns: Local/Free first routing tier before cloud escalation
security_notes: Local privacy preserves sensitive prompts on user machine

purpose: Autonomous assistant platform with local workspace memory and composable skill extensions.
capabilities: Skill registry with standardized manifest files
CLI, Web, and messaging interface adapters
architecture_patterns: Agentskills compatible structure: Instructions + Tools + Verification + Metadata
security_notes: Skills must undergo static code analysis before registration
